title: The back end serves SBC report data and export on ordinary reports access
refs: SV-8582 (SBC spec v20 2026-08-12 S1-R2; S1-N1 — one reports permission gates both the report data and the download)
preconds:
1. Two sign-ins are available: one user whose role has the ordinary reports access, and one whose role does not have it (for example a Foreman).
2. You need the browser's own developer tools so you can watch the requests the page makes: press F12 (or Ctrl+Shift+I; on a Mac Cmd+Option+I), open the "Network" tab, then reload the page. There is nothing to install — it is built into Chrome, Edge and Firefox. Each request in that list shows a small number that says whether it was allowed or refused.
steps:
1. Sign in as the user WITH ordinary reports access and open the Sales By Customer report; watch the Network tab as the report loads.
2. Still as that user, download the report; watch the Network tab again.
3. Sign out, sign in as the user WITHOUT reports access, and repeat both actions.
expected:
1. For the user WITH ordinary reports access, the report's data request is allowed (the Network tab shows the success number 200) and the report fills with rows.
2. For that same user, the download request is also allowed (success number 200) and a file is produced.
3. For the user WITHOUT reports access, the data request is refused (the Network tab shows the refusal number 403) and the screen reads "Access denied." — no report data comes back.
4. For that same user, the download request is refused in the same way — no file is produced.

Note for the tester: one single permission controls all four of these. If you find the report data refused but the download allowed, or the other way round, that is a failure — write down the number shown for both.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S1-R2; S1-N1), read on 26 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.
